title: What happened in AI — Oct 22, 2026
intro: AI coding agents are producing more code without more finished work, according to a 718-firm study, even as new agent runtimes and gates keep arriving.
DeepSeek reportedly closed a $15B round days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its products.
highlights: Harvard study of 718 firms: AI coding raises code volume, not completed work.
OpenAI's Patch the Planet helped find PHP2Shell flaws in core PHP.
DeepSeek reportedly raised about $15B, led by CATL and Tencent, after a US federal ban.
Modal open-sources Spindle for fine-tuning open models.
Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation.

categories.name: Coding agents: more code, same throughput
categories.summary: A 718-firm study finds AI-assisted code volume rises without a matching rise in completed work, while builders ship new embeddable and gated agent runtimes.

articles.title: Study Finds AI-generated Code Fails to Boost Productivity Due to Downstream Bottlenecks
articles.summary: Harvard study of 718 firms (Jellyfish data): coding agents raise code volume, but completed work doesn't keep pace because of downstream bottlenecks.

articles.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: A Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded
articles.summary: Vercel Labs' experimental fx is a Zig coding agent that runs as a CLI, script component or embedded library, including a WebAssembly build.

articles.title: The nightly Ralph loop: a coding agent that works my backlog and never merges
articles.summary: A nightly coding-agent loop works a backlog and never merges, leaving the merge decision to a human.

articles.title: Developer Behind the AI-Built Adobe Clones Says They Are “Not Anywhere Close to Ready
articles.summary: A developer used Claude Opus 5.5 to build open-source stand-ins for seven Adobe apps, then said they are not close to ready after projecting near parity in a month.

categories.name: Security: agents as both attack surface and bug finders
categories.summary: OpenAI's program helped find PHP core vulnerabilities, while agent-side defenses focus on local policy checks.

articles.title: [AINews] OpenAI’s Patch the Planet program is 1 of 2 parties to discover PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in core PHP affecting 70% of the web, using GPT-5.6 Sol; coordinated response over 2 months
articles.summary: OpenAI's Patch the Planet program was one of two parties to discover PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in core PHP, using GPT-5.6 Sol, with a two-month coordinated response.

articles.title: Show HN: Secure your AI agents on Mac
articles.summary: Plango is a Mac-native security tool that runs a local model to evaluate coding-agent actions against the lethal trifecta of data access, outside communication and untrusted content.

categories.name: Inference and training infrastructure for agents
categories.summary: Teams are trimming latency and cost in agent serving, and open training APIs are reaching smaller teams.

articles.title: Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles — Erik Bernhardsson, Modal CEO
articles.summary: Modal's CEO discusses elastic GPUs, sandbox growth and the economics of the agent cloud.

articles.title: Introducing our Training API
articles.summary: Modal's Spindle is an open-source API for fine-tuning open models; one command deploys a server that runs Tinker-compatible training code.

articles.title: Stream low-latency speech from AI agents using Kokoro TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI
articles.summary: AWS shows streaming each sentence of an agent's reply to a Kokoro-82M TTS model on SageMaker AI so speech starts before the full response is ready.

articles.title: Expanding Claude availability and deployment choice on Google Cloud
articles.summary: Google Cloud expands Claude availability and deployment options for developers.

articles.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
